title: Demonic Path Ambush
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was lost in deep contemplation, a familiar cold aura approached silently—Ye Qing's figure emerged from the shadows, her eyes flickering with complex emotions, as if she had something urgent to say.

text.content: The lingering shadows of the ancient will receded like a tide, and Chen Ji felt a sharp piercing pain in his mind. The long-buried truth—that the Tianji Record was both shackle and key, that his bloodline carried the first key to unlock the prison of fate—everything felt like a dull blade, scraping back and forth across his heart. He took a deep breath, about to sort through his chaotic thoughts, when his perception suddenly caught a cold aura fluctuation. Someone was approaching. And not just one.

dialogue.content: (Cold laugh) How convenient. Coming to take advantage while my soul is unstable—the Demonic Path truly has no ambition.

text.content: Chen Ji didn't move, allowing that aura to approach. He could sense at least three assailants, all experts at the late Foundation Building stage, with one aura particularly sinister and bizarre—clearly a Demonic Path elite specializing in assassination. They chose to strike while the ancient being's power fluctuations hadn't fully subsided, obviously well-prepared. But what they didn't know was that while Chen Ji's Tianji Record was in cooldown, his perception and mental calculations had never gone offline.

dialogue.content: (A cold voice echoed from the darkness) Chen Ji, did you think I would let you leave this area alive? By the Holy Sect's order, you must die here today.

text.content: Before the words even finished, three black shadows erupted simultaneously, blocking Chen Ji's retreat from three directions. The leader held a jet-black short blade,诡异魔纹 flowing across its surface—a Demonic Path treasure specifically designed to pierce protective spiritual light. His smile was cruel and confident, as if he had already seen the scene of Chen Ji's blood splattering across the ground.

dialogue.content: (Clapping lightly) The Holy Sect's order? Interesting. Does your commander know about your擅自行动? Or is this... what your commander authorized?

text.content: The leader's eyes flickered slightly, clearly not expecting Chen Ji to remain so calm in this situation. His short blade paused momentarily, then he grinned wickedly: "The commander? After I kill you, the Holy Sect will credit me with the primary achievement. As for the commander—" He paused, his smile growing increasingly sinister, "He won't have any objections."

choice.prompt: Facing the encirclement by Demonic Path assassins, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.text: Luring the Snake Out of Its Den
choices.description: Deliberately showing weakness, letting the enemy believe victory is imminent, tempting them to reveal more information and hidden的手段.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain critical intelligence, exposing the cracks within the Demonic Path
choices.risk_hint: Requires precise control of injuries, otherwise may backfire

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes hardened, his body swaying slightly, as if genuinely affected by the ancient will's lingering influence. He stumbled back two steps, one hand clutching his chest, feigning a weak posture of turbulent qi and blood. The performance was flawless.

choices.description: While the enemy hasn't fully encircled, strike with thunderous force to defeat one of them, disrupting their包围阵型.
choices.visible_reward: Intimidate the enemy, displaying true capabilities
choices.risk_hint: May reveal too many trump cards, drawing attention from more factions

text.content: A slight smirk curled on Chen Ji's lips, his eyes flickering with cold light. He didn't retreat—instead, he stepped forward, spiritual energy condensing into a sharp sword qi at his fingertips, targeting the enemy on the left with the weakest aura!

The moment Chen Ji chose to lure the snake out, he deliberately delayed his reaction by half a beat. The Demonic Path assassin's dagger, carrying chilling demonic energy, accurately pierced toward his left shoulder—'Splat!' Blood splattered. Chen Ji let out a muffled grunt, his body stumbling sideways, but the blade had only entered shallowly—he had shifted half an inch at the critical moment. The pain was real, but his life was truly saved.

dialogue.content: (The leader burst into wild laughter) Hahaha! What a Tianji Record inheritor—nothing but a worthless fraud! Can't even dodge my strike, yet dares to oppose the Holy Sect?

text.content: Chen Ji clutched his wound, a trickle of blood at the corner of his lips, yet his gaze was terrifyingly calm. He slowly raised his head, looking at the laughing assassin, the corners of his mouth lifting into a meaningful smile. That smile struck an inexplicable chill into the leader's heart, and his laughter abruptly ceased.

dialogue.content: (Lightly laughing) Can't dodge? If I truly couldn't dodge, that blade should have pierced my heart just now. Take another look at where you actually struck. All bark and no bite? Your commander sent you, probably hoping I'd be the one to clean up your mess.

text.content: The leader's face changed abruptly. Instinctively, he glanced at his dagger—the strike had indeed deviated. Not his error, but Chen Ji had shifted his body at the final moment. Yet he had clearly sealed off all escape routes. How could this be? Chen Ji's fingers, still pressed against his wound, subtly formed a technique. A barely perceptible thread of spiritual energy shot from his sleeve, coiling around the leader's ankle.

In that moment of hesitation, Chen Ji erupted with overwhelming force. All the spiritual energy he had quietly gathered while feigning weakness now exploded outward. His palm struck the leader's chest with devastating impact. The sickening crack of bone echoed as the leader's body soared backward like a broken kite. Then Chen Ji's form blurred, ghostlike as he swept toward the remaining assassins—his movements fluid and natural, completely shedding any appearance of previous weakness.

dialogue.content: (Retreating in terror) You... you were pretending! It was all an act! Damn it, we've walked into a trap!

text.content: Chen Ji ignored his shrieks, his fingers dancing to seal both men's acupoints. Then he approached the leader, whose chest was shattered and body broken on the ground. Crouching down, he gripped the man's jaw with blood-stained fingers, forcing eye contact.

dialogue.content: (Smiling gently, his voice cold as ice) I'll give you one more chance to organize your thoughts. Who sent you? Your Holy Sect, or your commander... who has other schemes?

choice.prompt: How should we deal with these demonic path assassins?

choices.text: Kill the chicken to frighten the monkeys
choices.description: Execute the leader on the spot and send his head to the demonic camp—both a warning and a declaration of war.
choices.visible_cost: Break completely with the demonic path
choices.visible_reward: Deter the minor demons of the demonic path and elevate reputation in the martial world
choices.risk_hint: May provoke more frantic retaliation from the demonic path

dialogue.content: (Pressing his fingers firmly) Since you wanted me dead, I'll grant your wish. But you can choose the method—quick and painless, or... slowly tortured?

choices.description: Use the Tianji Record Fragment's pressure to extract intelligence—we must discover what exactly is happening within the demonic path.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain core intelligence from within the demonic path; may uncover a larger conspiracy
choices.risk_hint: Intelligence may be partially true or false—requires careful verification

dialogue.content: (Releasing his grip, speaking calmly) Death would be too merciful for you. I want to know why your commander wanted me dead. Was it a genuine Holy Sect order, or... were there other motives?

text.content: The leader was crushed by Chen Ji's imposing presence. The arrogance on his face had vanished completely, replaced by profound fear. He struggled to look away, but Chen Ji's fingers held his jaw in an iron grip, leaving him unable to move even slightly. Under the gaze of those eyes, calm as a deep abyss, he felt as if every mask had been stripped away—any deception would be exposed under that penetrating stare.

dialogue.content: (Speaking tremulously) I-it's the commander's orders! He said you're someone the Holy Sect marked for death—kill you, and we'll receive the Holy Sect's core technique as a reward! We were just following orders, truly— it wasn't our idea!

text.content: Chen Ji slightly narrowed his eyes. The commander's orders, the Holy Sect's reward—this answer seemed plausible, but was full of holes. If it truly were a Holy Sect order, Ye Qing, as the demonic path saint, would certainly know about it. And if the reward were the motive, the commander could have acted personally—why send these incompetent assassins to die? Chen Ji's fingers gently tapped the man's jaw, producing a rhythmic sound, each tap striking the leader's heart like a hammer.

dialogue.content: (Smiling) It seems you're not very good at telling the truth. Let me rephrase the question—has your commander recently had disagreements with Holy Sect higher-ups? Did he send you to kill me to frame the Holy Sect, or to use my hand... to stir up trouble in these murky waters?

text.content: The leader's pupils contracted sharply—this reaction spoke louder than any words. Chen Ji knew he had guessed correctly. There was indeed division within the demonic path. That mysterious commander wasn't entirely loyal to the Holy Sect; he was secretly accumulating power, intending to stand independently. And Chen Ji's identity as the 'Tianji Record inheritor' happened to be a piece he could use. Killing Chen Ji could earn credit with the Holy Sect; keeping Chen Ji alive could destabilize the situation. A truly clever calculation serving two purposes.

dialogue.content: (Trembling with fear) How... how do you know? This is impossible—how could such a thing leak out! Who exactly are you?!

text.content: Chen Ji released his hand and slowly stood up. He did not answer the other person's question, merely looking down at these three trembling Demonic Path assassins with a trace of disgust in his eyes. These people were merely chess pieces; the true chess master was still watching from the shadows. He lightly brushed the dust from his sleeves and turned to gaze toward the distant Demonic Path camp. There, a greater storm was brewing.

dialogue.content: (Murmuring to himself) There are divisions within the Demonic Path, and the Holy Sect is certainly not a monolithic bloc. It seems in this chaotic world, no one is completely trustworthy. Their commander wants to use me, but I refuse to play into his hands.

text.content: After dealing with the assassins, Chen Ji found a secluded cave to rest. He sat cross-legged, took a healing elixir, and began to sort through the intelligence he had obtained today. The Demonic Path commander had ulterior motives—this was a significant discovery. It meant that in the coming great battle, besides dealing with the scheming between the three major sects and the Holy Sect, he would also need to guard against hidden daggers within the Demonic Path. More importantly, Ye Qing—that Demonic Path Saint—where did she stand in this chess game?

dialogue.content: (A familiar voice echoes from the shadows) It seems you are more formidable than I imagined. Three Foundation Building late-stage assassins, plus a Demonic Path supreme treasure specialized in shattering protective spiritual light—all easily resolved by you. Chen Ji, you have hidden yourself quite deeply.

text.content: Chen Ji did not turn around, merely speaking calmly: "You arrived at just the right time. Those three assassins were your people—you surely knew they would come today." He paused, then continued, "Or perhaps you came specifically to see how I would handle this situation?"

choice.prompt: How will Chen Ji respond to Ye Qing's arrival?

choices.description: Directly question Ye Qing, making her clarify her position and role in this matter.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Ye Qing's trust and understand the true situation within the Demonic Path
choices.risk_hint: If Ye Qing has ulterior motives, may expose more information

dialogue.content: (Turns around, gaze like a blade) Ye Qing, did you come to watch my humiliation, or to demand an accounting? Shouldn't you give me an explanation regarding the Demonic Path's internal affairs?

choices.description: First observe Ye Qing's attitude, not rushing to tear apart the relationship, leaving room for maneuver for both sides.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily unable to obtain complete intelligence
choices.visible_reward: Maintain cooperative relationship with Ye Qing, preserve strength
choices.risk_hint: May be seen as weak and easily bullied by Ye Qing

dialogue.content: (Smiles faintly) Ye Qing, Saint, your presence honors me. I wonder what brings you here so late at night?

text.content: Ye Qing's figure slowly emerged from the shadows. Moonlight fell upon her pallid face, revealing a complex expression. She looked at Chen Ji, her eyes carrying scrutiny, surprise, and an indescribable emotion. After a moment of silence, she spoke, her voice more serious than ever before: "Chen Ji, I came tonight to tell you something. About our commander... about the truth within the Demonic Path." Her gaze fell upon Chen Ji as she continued, "Are you willing to listen?"

dialogue.content: (Smiles faintly) Go ahead, I'm listening. But I must warn you—if there's a single false word in what you say, I will know.

text.content: Ye Qing took a deep breath, as if making some decisive determination. She slowly walked to sit across from Chen Ji. Moonlight poured through the cave entrance, stretching their shadows long. In this moment, she was no longer the高高在上的 Demonic Path Saint, but a chess piece caught by fate and unable to act freely. "Our commander..." she began, her voice somewhat hoarse, "is not actually a person of the Holy Sect."

Chen Ji's eyes slightly narrowed, yet he did not display much surprise. He gestured for Ye Qing to continue. Her gaze became somewhat distant, as if recalling some unwilling memories. "Three years ago, a coup occurred within the Holy Sect. The current commander was one of the key figures in that coup. On the surface, he served the Holy Sect, but in truth, he has been secretly accumulating power, intending to seize the throne. And I..." she smiled bitterly, "am merely a chess piece in his hands."

Ye Qing's words were like a key, unlocking a lock of doubt that had long resided in Chen Ji's heart. So that was it. The Demonic Path commander was not a loyal hound of the Holy Sect, but an ambitious hero. Sending assassins to kill Chen Ji was less about following the Holy Sect's orders and more about using Chen Ji's death to create chaos, allowing himself to fish in troubled waters. And Ye Qing, this saint pushed to the forefront, was merely a tool to mislead others.

dialogue.content: (Raises head, directly meeting Chen Ji's gaze) I know what you're thinking. You're wondering why I'm telling you this. It's simple—because I want to survive. I want to break free from his control. And you... you are the only hope I've seen.

text.content: Ye Qing's words lingered in the air, carrying determination and earnestness. Chen Ji looked at her, at those eyes that had once been cold as ice now rippling with emotion. He did not immediately respond, falling into brief silence. In this moment, he needed to weigh too many things—how much of Ye Qing's words were credible? What exactly was her relationship with the commander? What did her so-called "hope" mean?

dialogue.content: (After a moment of contemplation) You say you want to survive, to break free from his control. But how do I know this isn't just another trap set by your master? Perhaps your appearance here tonight was at his command.

text.content: A hint of bitterness crossed Ye Qing's face. She didn't argue, but instead nodded: 'Your suspicion is understandable. If I were in your position, I wouldn't believe easily either. But Chen Ji, have you considered—if I wanted to harm you, when those three assassins struck, I could have attacked from the shadows, catching you between enemies.' She paused, then continued, 'But I didn't. I even warned you in advance so you could prepare.'

Chen Ji recalled the earlier battle and indeed noticed something peculiar. Those three assassins' attacks, though fierce, had subtle flaws in their coordination, as if deliberately arranged. At the time, he thought his tactic of feigning weakness to lure the enemy had worked, but now it seemed Ye Qing's hidden manipulations were the key. She was protecting him. This realization shifted the balance in Chen Ji's heart somewhat, but his cautious nature kept him on guard.

Ye Qing seemed to sense Chen Ji's wavering. She stood up, walked to the cave entrance, her back to Chen Ji. Moonlight outlined her silhouette into a cold, clear contour. 'I know you still can't fully trust me, and that's fine.' Her voice was soft, yet carried an unusual firmness, 'But I can promise you one thing—from now on, I will do everything in my power to help you investigate the truth within the Demonic Path. Whatever I find, I will tell you immediately.'

dialogue.content: (Turning around, eyes burning intensely) Of course, that的前提是你愿意给我这个机会。如果你觉得我不可信，大可以现在就拒绝。我夜清说话算话，绝不会因此记恨于你。

text.content: The mountain cave fell into silence, broken only by the occasional howling wind outside. Chen Ji's gaze lingered on Ye Qing for a long while—he was examining, judging, weighing. After a long moment, he suddenly laughed softly, breaking the silence. That laugh held no mockery, no hostility, only a hint of amusement.

dialogue.content: (With a knowing smile) Ye Saint, do you know there's a saying in my homeland: 'Unbidden kindness always hides sinister motives'? However, since you're so sincere, I'm not a petty man. Here's my proposal—give me a token first to prove your sincerity. How about that?

text.content: Ye Qing was stunned for a moment, then understood Chen Ji's meaning. She looked down at herself, then finally untied a completely black jade pendant from her waist. The pendant was carved with intricate demonic patterns, emanating a cold, eerie glow—it was the identity token of the Demon Path Saint, and also the key credential controlling demonic arts.

dialogue.content: (Handing the jade pendant to Chen Ji) This is my Saint's Decree, and also the key to my control over the Demonic Path's illusions. Holding this gives you leverage over a part of my life force. If I have any thought of betrayal, you only need to destroy this object, and my cultivation will greatly diminish.

text.content: Chen Ji took the jade pendant. When his fingertips touched the cool jade, an odd energy surged into his body along his meridians. He could feel the powerful Demonic Path aura contained within this pendant, as well as the spiritual imprint Ye Qing had left on it. She wasn't lying—this truly was her lifeline. Surrendering something so important to a potential enemy, Ye Qing was either truly at the end of her rope, or making a desperate gamble. Either way, Chen Ji found things becoming increasingly interesting.

dialogue.content: (Playing with the jade pendant in hand) Fine. Since the Saint is so sincere, I, Chen Ji, accept this gesture. But let me be clear—I have a good memory. Whoever has helped me, whoever has harmed me, I remember clearly. If anyone wants to stab me in the back someday, they'd better weigh their own worth first.

text.content: When Ye Qing heard this, the corners of her mouth lifted slightly, revealing a rare smile. That smile held relief, anticipation, and a trace of ambiguous intimacy. She bowed slightly to Chen Ji, her voice much softer: 'Then, pleasant cooperation.' With that, her figure melted into the night as silently as she had arrived.

After Ye Qing left, silence returned to the cave. Chen Ji sat alone in the darkness, the Saint's Decree in his hand. The developments were far smoother than he had anticipated—the Demonic Path had internal divisions, the commander had ulterior motives, and Ye Qing, who should have been an enemy, had actually come seeking cooperation. All this seemed like coincidence, but Chen Ji knew—how could there be so many coincidences in this world? Behind every chance lies inevitable cause and effect. He mentally noted: The Demonic Path commander is in danger.

However, Chen Ji was not drunk on this sudden good news. He was very clear that though Ye Qing's words sounded sincere, they probably contained quite a bit of exaggeration. She said she wanted to survive, wanted to escape control—these were likely true. But besides being at the end of her rope, could there be other considerations for choosing to show goodwill at this time? Chen Ji decided to believe her for now, but also keep an ace up his sleeve. After all, in this turbulent world, the most unreliable thing is the human heart.

He secured the Saint's Decree and closed his eyes, beginning to regulate his breath and heal his wounds. Though today's battle had been without major mishap, it made him realize his strength still had much room for improvement. The truth awakened from the ancient will's remnant—the Tianji Record being both shackle and key, his bloodline being the first key to opening the prison of fate—what did this mean? Chen Ji faintly felt he had touched the edge of some enormous secret, but specific answers required further exploration.

Night wind blew in from the cave entrance, carrying a chill. But a fire burned in Chen Ji's heart—a thirst for truth, a pursuit of power, a rebellion against fate. He knew starting tonight, his entanglement with the Demonic Path would enter a new phase. Old scores remained unsettled, new enemies had arrived. But so what? Chen Ji had never feared challenges in his life.

Just as Chen Ji was lost in thought, a familiar, cold aura silently approached. His eyes snapped open, his pupils reflecting a figure slowly emerging from the shadows—Ye Qing's return once more stirred ripples in this quiet cave. Her eyes flickered with complex light, as if she had important words to say.
